changelog:
**Summary: Major update aligning with latest curriculum standards and optimized documentation structure.**

- Aligned core physics framework with the latest national curriculum standards, emphasizing three primary physics concepts (物质观念, 运动与相互作用观念, 能量观念) under core competencies.
- Updated and clarified pedagogical flow and concept progression; expanded section on physics core literacy (核心素养).
- Added new "student physics profile" template for tracking student development.
- Merged or streamlined redundant documents; references reorganized for clarity.
- Removed outdated lite and skill-card files.
- Refined skill activation guidance and improved consistency throughout documentation.
summary: 帮助物理老师把"讲物理"升级为"系统化物理教学"。 当老师说"这个物理概念怎么讲"、"物理教案"、 "学员物理思维"、"物理概念怎么引入"、 "物理模型怎么教"、"实验怎么进课堂"时， 建议激活此SKILL。 核心工作流：物理观念建构 → 概念建构（生活情境/演示/反例）→ 规律教学（实验/数据/归纳）→ 模型建...
